ref: #2 §3: ifWithoutElse passes its then input where the condition is true; its else value is a function parameter, and the empty-string else value is skipped while the SUPPRESS one keeps its slot and the queues in step [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/5d/db0e83e8e74202a5bff527055ab7e5/content.htm] [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bf416d9eaca4c86e10000000a42189e.html]; assumed reading of #78: a context function whose box parameter keepSuppressValues (PO's "Keep SUPPRESS Values", label and default [COMM]) is false by default, so a false condition leaves no slot, and true gives SUPPRESS at the slot; only the exact text true is true (#77); obs-ifwithoutelse (#35) and obs-boolean decide it; SUPPRESS in an input gives SUPPRESS at its slot whatever the parameter, as in a Lift (ADR-0006 bullet 2)
note: ifWithoutElse(Sku, createIf(Qty)), both in context Orders, without params, onto Item; V is Qty in context Line. Lines (true, 1), (false, 0), (false, TRUE), (true, true): createIf gives "", SUPPRESS, "", "". The SUPPRESS of line 2 stays at slot 2, though its condition is false, and the false line 3 leaves no slot, so the Items of slots 1 and 3 read the Qty of lines 1 and 3. Were the input SUPPRESS dropped with the false line, V would be 1 and 0.
